description: Display of 1no. non-illuminated lettering fascia sign, and 1no. non-illuminated logo sign applied to the glazing to the front elevation fronting Hopgood Street.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The period of this consent shall expire 5 years from the date of this notice. 

Condition required to be imposed by the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) Regulations 2007.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

202 - Proposed elevation

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The signage hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the following materials:

- Fascia sign: Letters - acrylic or stainless steel, finished with gold mirror acrylic or PVD gold metal. 

The signage shall be retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC8 and DC9 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - The advertisements hereby granted consent shall not illuminated at any time. 

In the interests of visual amenity, residential amenity, and highway safety, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC9, CC12 and T1 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principles of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
